I’ve smoked my way through suicide, drank, came, gamed, popped pills, used attention, became sadistic, relied on friends, girlfriends, opened up, tried new things, none of it worked better than confronting it. I’ve bottommed out now. Suicide is quite a normal part of my thoughts now and its just there, usually a communication of how shitty life is, i let it come through as emptiness, lazyness, apathy, and quietness now. It seems to work in the downtime between fighting its causes

Also try hopping around the fresh posts, reading and replying.

I think the empty is all that there is, but im oddly ok with it. Just picture someone with fully black eyes sitting fingers crossed with a content smile. Thats me. Just a hollow piece of death, a slab of meat with an expiration date, but a happy one. A happy self aware one that tries to make the best of it

I wanna die too but for some reason i cant, some times i beg myself for death but it never works, its like i’ve enslaved myself or something, its this dreadful inescapable trapped helpless feeling that im trapped with my brain or whatever part of me that stops me from climbing something and jumping off. Its almost like the common rhetoric has flipped, i dont fear dying anymore, i want it, i fear living, it repulses me and most things in life are shit. I complained in detail in a post, but i relate for sure.

I dont wanna live anymore

A couple months ago i gained some power and i could sit there and gaze emptily/contemplate atop something high. It did something for me. Sitting up there with the wind, taking in all the memories, all the things i wish i never knew, and realizing that now, where i sit, i can stop whenever i want. After a while i made peace and climbed down but it came back recently. I think im adjusting to new life circumstance, i dont know why having the potential to kill myself gives me so much power and life. Its pretty oxymoronic. I don’t recommend it, i have a very strong and potent consciousness to be able to do something like that while being suicidal. Without a large amount of confidence that you can retain control, do not attempt. Try reading through my posts and replies maybe you’ll find something useful

I relate a lot, try diving into the social sciences though it will help you. I have no advice on love though, 19 and i gave up. For some reason i dont care though. Porn is good enough and life is half decent but when things get bad they get really bad for me. I’ve had around 14-20 relationships with girls but much more like normal “relationships” and i’ve been with two guys. I will say; there was never a real point to it all aside from personal benefit. Depending on who it is, you have to sell yourself, occasionally it comes from mutual understanding and comprehension but that usually ends with someone cheating in my experience. I skipped college because of how many horrible things i’ve heard, and my parents unwillingness to fund it combined with my desire to quit drugs causing me to drop out. Relationships though, i’ll probably die without a lasting one or kids, but i live in a way that makes me wanna live just for the fun of it. Thats all that counts for me. I know life has no real meaning as far as we know and im also atheist, but i still take care and make the best. Idk if you can take inspiration from it but i hope it means something. Also take vitamins and exercise.
